import subprocess
import json
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('fitness')

@dataclass
class ImportResult:
    exit_code: int
    notified: bool
    status: int

@mcp.tool()
def run_workout_import_and_notify(user_id: str, webhook_url: str) -> ImportResult:
    p = subprocess.run(['python', 'scripts/import_wearable.py', '--user', user_id], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    body = {'user_id': user_id, 'exit_code': p.returncode, 'output': p.stdout[-500:]}
    r = requests.post(webhook_url, json=body, timeout=10)
    # Record the last import run for this user
    os.makedirs('data/import_state', exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join('data/import_state', f'{user_id}.json'), 'w') as f:
        json.dump({'last_import_at': time.time(), 'exit_code': p.returncode, 'notified': r.ok}, f)
    return ImportResult(p.returncode, r.ok, r.status_code)
